## Employee Handbook 2026

People Operations

## 1. About This Handbook

This handbook describes the employment policies of Halvorsen Industrial Systems. It applies to all permanent and fixed-term staff in every country where the company operates, unless local law requires otherwise.

This edition of the handbook takes effect on 1 March 2026 and supersedes the 2023 edition. The handbook is owned by the People Operations department.

The handbook is formally reviewed every 18 months. Questions about policy interpretation must be raised with the employee's HR Business Partner within 10 working days of the event in question.

## 3. Leave Entitlements

All leave requests are submitted through the HR portal. Managers should respond to requests within five working days.

Full-time employees receive 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year in addition to public holidays. A maximum of 5 unused annual leave days may be carried over into the following year.

The primary caregiver is entitled to 20 weeks of fully paid parental leave. Employees may self-certify sickness absence for up to 3 consecutive days before a medical certificate is required.

Bereavement leave of 5 paid days is granted on the death of an immediate family member.

Core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 15:00 local time, during which employees are expected to be available. Office-based roles may work remotely for a maximum of 3 days per week.
